alt.en: Two gilded floral finials have curling stems, flowers and textured seed pods.
alt.zh: 两件鎏金花卉饰件带有弯曲枝茎、花朵与纹理细密的莲蓬。

caption.en: Pair of lotus finials, attributed to Golconda, about 1650–1680; gilded copper, Met 2024.277a,b.
caption.zh: 一对莲花饰件，归于戈尔康达，约1650—1680年；鎏金铜，大都会2024.277a,b。

interpretation.en: The Met relates finials of this type to decorated palanquins in elite processions. The attribution does not identify a particular owner.
interpretation.zh: 大都会将此类饰件与精英出行时装饰华丽的轿舆联系起来；归属判断并未确定某位主人。

items.creator: Unrecorded maker

title.en: A Jain teacher on a lion throne

alt.en: A seated copper-alloy figure meditates above a tiered throne, flanked by two smaller figures.
alt.zh: 铜合金坐像在层叠宝座上冥想，两侧各有一尊较小人物像。

caption.en: Enthroned Jina, probably Neminatha, late seventh century, Akota, Gujarat; Met 2008.279.
caption.zh: 宝座上的耆那，可能为内米那陀，七世纪晚期，古吉拉特阿科塔；大都会2008.279。

interpretation.en: The identification as Neminatha remains probable. The museum records a Sanskrit donor inscription on the reverse, which is not shown in this frontal photograph.
interpretation.zh: 内米那陀的身份仍属推定。博物馆记载背面有梵文供养铭文，本张正面照片未显示该铭文。

title.en: U Paw Hnyun’s embroidered Thiri Rama
title.zh: 吴波纽绣制的缅甸罗摩故事

alt.en: A wide textile hanging arranges many figures, buildings, trees and animals in richly embroidered horizontal bands.
alt.zh: 宽幅织绣挂饰以横向带状布局呈现众多人物、建筑、树木与动物，装饰繁密。

caption.en: U Paw Hnyun, scenes from Thiri Rama, about 1870–1885, Myanmar; appliqué and embroidery on velvet, The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
caption.zh: 吴波纽，缅甸《罗摩衍那》故事场景，约1870—1885年，缅甸；天鹅绒贴布绣与刺绣，大都会艺术博物馆藏。

interpretation.en: This named maker’s narrative hanging is a different textile tradition from the Karen objects discussed in the entry. Repeated characters mark selected scenes, not one continuous episode.
interpretation.zh: 这件具名匠人的叙事挂饰，与条目讨论的克伦族织物属于不同的纺织传统。重复出现的人物呈现选取的场景，而非单一连续情节。

items.credit: Purchase, Friends of Asian Art Gifts, 2021

title.zh: 卡卡提亚时期的毗湿奴像

alt.en: A tall stone relief frames a standing crowned deity with elaborate jewelry and smaller figures near the feet.
alt.zh: 高大石雕中，戴冠神祇站立于装饰框内，佩戴繁复饰物，脚边有较小人物。

caption.en: Vishnu accompanied by Garuda and Lakshmi, twelfth–thirteenth century, Kakatiya period; Met 57.51.2.
caption.zh: 毗湿奴与迦楼罗、吉祥天，十二至十三世纪，卡卡提亚时期；大都会57.51.2。

interpretation.en: The Met identifies this work as a Kakatiya-period stone sculpture from South India. It is not identified as a sculpture from the Palampet temple.
interpretation.zh: 大都会将此作识别为南印度卡卡提亚时期石雕；馆录并未将其确定为帕兰佩特寺庙的雕像。
